A '''fleet''' of<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> twelve<ref name="Complete Locations" /> [[Rothana Heavy Engineering]] [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship|''Acclamator''-class assault ships]] were secretly built for the [[Ruling Council (Kamino)|Kaminoan government's]] secret [[Grand Army of the Republic|clone army]] meant for the [[Galactic Republic]]. When [[Jedi Master]] [[Yoda]] arrived to take command of the [[army]], the [[fleet]] of already completed [[assault ship]]s were immediately sent to [[Kamino]] to embark the [[clone trooper]] army. Some [[Cloning|clone]] units had received training to [[pilot]] the vessels, and carried out their posts with efficiency.<ref name="Encyclopedia" />

Once the<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> two [[Sector Army|Sector Armies]]<ref name="Complete Locations" /> were embarked, the fleet traveled to [[Geonosis]] to reinforce the [[Jedi assault team]] who was being massacred. Despite the size of the assault ships, they were maneuverable in [[atmosphere]], and as such took [[Confederacy of Independent Systems|Separatist Alliance]] defenders by surprise. The fleet then deployed [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry|LAAT/i gunships]] to assist the [[Jedi]]<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> while several of the assault ships landed and began deploying ground forces.<ref name="Episode II">{{Film|II}}</ref>
